Q17.purpose: Calculate email share of total sessions and total orders for each month (August vs September 2026)
Q17.sql:
WITH traffic AS (
    SELECT date,
           SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
           SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'email' THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS email_sessions
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic
    WHERE to_date(date) >= '2026-08-01'
      AND to_date(date) < '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY date
),
orders AS (
    SELECT date,
           COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
           SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'email' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS email_orders
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
    WHERE to_date(date) >= '2026-08-01'
      AND to_date(date) < '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY date
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT t.date,
           t.total_sessions,
           t.email_sessions,
           o.total_orders,
           o.email_orders
    FROM traffic t
    JOIN orders o ON t.date = o.date
)
SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       email_sessions,
       total_sessions,
       ROUND(email_sessions / total_sessions, 3) AS email_share_sessions,
       email_orders,
       total_orders,
       ROUND(email_orders / total_orders, 3) AS email_share_orders
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

Q26.purpose: Compare revenue and order share by product_id for August vs September overall
Q26.sql:
WITH orders_month AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE) AS revenue,
    1 AS order_cnt
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
  WHERE date >= '2026-06-01' AND date <= '2026-09-30'
),
monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(order_cnt) AS total_orders
  FROM orders_month
  GROUP BY month
),
product_month AS (
  SELECT
    om.product_id,
    om.month,
    om.revenue,
    om.order_cnt,
    tm.total_revenue,
    tm.total_orders
  FROM orders_month om
  JOIN monthly_totals tm ON om.month = tm.month
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  month,
  om.revenue / tm.total_revenue AS revenue_share,
  CAST(om.order_cnt AS DOUBLE) / tm.total_orders AS orders_share
FROM product_month
WHERE month IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
ORDER BY product_id, month;

        WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
